name: Endless Riches
texts: When you play this, banish your hand and trash, then [Burn 7]. Skip your Draw Phase. You may play cards from your trash. If a card would go to your trash from anywhere other than your Main Deck, banish it instead.
manual: When you play this, banish your hand and trash, then [Burn 7].
You may play cards from your trash.
If a card would go to your trash from anywhere other than your Main Deck, banish it instead.
